jvm_path.description: Path to the Java executable or JVM name.

user.description: User account under which the daemon will run.

working_dir.description: Working directory for the daemon process.

classpath.description: Classpath for the Java service classes and resources.

main_class.description: The main class implementing the Daemon interface.

pidfile.description: Path to the file containing the PID of jsvc.

outfile.description: Location for output from stdout (e.g., /dev/null, SYSLOG, or a file).

errfile.description: Location for output from stderr (e.g., /dev/null, SYSLOG, or a file).

umask.description: File mode creation mask for the daemon.

java_home.description: Path to the JDK or JRE installation.

jvm_options.description: Virtual Machine specific options (e.g., -server, -Xmx256m). This is a list of strings.

java_system_properties.description: Java system properties to set using -D (e.g., -Djava.awt.headless=true). This is a list of strings.
